description: The touchpad map of QNC (user 2026-10-18: every input device is a block with its own map). A role is what a gesture does over a panel: jog = the panel's wheel (the left/right arrow), level = Ctrl+wheel (the level of a taken A1/A2 sound), undo = undo (up, away from the user) or redo (down) of the story where the panel maps it (user 2026-10-29: left-right for the markers, up-down for undo-redo), none = nothing. On Windows a two-finger swipe arrives as fine wheel steps and a pinch as Ctrl with them; on macOS a pinch is its own gesture.
